functions.name: CerosApi
functions.description: Fetches experiences from the Ceros REST API using a securely stored API key.

actions.name: CerosApi
actions.description: Fetches experiences from the Ceros REST API via the CerosApi Contentful Function.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: One of: getFolderTree | getFolderExperiences | getEmbedCode | resolveExperience

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: JSON string of query params for the target endpoint (whitelisted per action)

parameters.name: Experience URL
parameters.description: Required for resolveExperience — the pasted experience URL
